name: Change Request
notes: Requestor and Category print as labels with a colon below the title line, with no rule and no box, so they sit in the body rather than the title block; the Requestor value goes on the same line as its label. The Category boxes print in a 3 by 2 grid read row by row. The text block Impacts of Change is a printed section heading with no box of its own. Each impact area prints as a bordered row (bold area name, then Increase, Decrease, Modify boxes) with a Description box directly under it. Stakeholder Impact offers High risk, Low risk, Medium risk in that printed order. Project Documents prints as a bold label inside the same bordered box as the Stakeholder Impact Description, with no Increase, Decrease or Modify boxes of its own; it is where the impact on project documents is described. Disposition prints on page 3 with its three boxes on the same line, and the Justification box under it is a separate box from the Justification for Proposed Change on page 1. Disagreements with the prose table (Table 3.3), where the blank form wins: prose Description of change versus printed Detailed Description of Proposed Change; the prose lists Project documents as one of the Impacts of change, while the form prints Project Documents only as a label inside the Stakeholder Impact box; the prose table has no Stakeholder Impact, Disposition or page 3 Justification element, and it does not list the Category box options (the form prints Documents among them).
